meta.title: Absolute Color Recognition
meta.subTitle: Color Recognition
meta.desc: Deconstruct the HSV/OKLab color space. Build perceptual acuity through progressive identification of Hue, Value, and Saturation.

color_hue.title: Hue
color_hue.desc: Identify the exact angle of a color on the 360° color wheel.
color_hue.instruction: Locate the exact degree of the color on the 360° color wheel.

color_val.title: Value
color_val.desc: Given hue, estimate the lightness/darkness value (0%~100%).
color_val.instruction: Estimate the value/brightness percentage of the color (0%~100%).

color_sat.title: Saturation
color_sat.desc: Given hue and value, estimate the purity and saturation (0%~100%).
color_sat.instruction: Estimate the saturation purity percentage of the color (0%~100%).

color_all.title: Full Color Match
color_all.desc: Simultaneously adjust Hue, Saturation, and Value to match the target color.
color_all.instruction: Modulate H, S, and V tracks to match the target color on the left.
